diagnosis.scope: Historical foreground-failure diagnosis; see verified_run_20261014 for the subsequent encoding fix and successful UI test
diagnosis.source: blindly4/windows/Input/Native.cs: Activate calls SetForegroundWindow, waits for the foreground PID, then calls RequireForeground
diagnosis.underlying_cause: Unconfirmed; no evidence yet distinguishes a denied foreground switch from focus contention or other launch-context differences
diagnosis.reproducibility: Foreground activation error observed in two managed Sapiens attempts; intermittent/context-dependent behavior remains possible because a foreground-prepared attempt passed that boundary and a direct invocation succeeded

foreground_retest.tool_error: 'charmap' codec can't encode character '\u25cf' in position 839: character maps to <undefined>
foreground_retest.error_evidence: Confirmed in the execution session's completed CommandExecution record
foreground_retest.diagnostic: The local Python stdout defaults to cp1252; the same read through commands.py with -X utf8 and the configured binary override returned valid Unicode UI data successfully. This diagnostic was outside the managed Sapi workspace and alone does not prove end-to-end success.
